decisions.reason: The construction site dumper appears to have had the weakest initial commitment and, after roughly three years, limited visible support suggests enough uncertainty has resolved to justify abandoning this option and reallocating resources.
The inclined furniture lift was given its own product page and likely fits a niche lifting portfolio, so the firm would plausibly keep the option open if ongoing carrying costs are modest.
The inclined building material lift seems to benefit from platform and market overlap with the other inclined lifts, lowering the cost of waiting and supporting continuation.
The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is a narrower and likely more complex variant, so if clear traction has not emerged by 2022 the firm would be somewhat more likely to discontinue it.
